description.zh: 选择查询新版安全分或旧版安全分规则，当取值为**home_security_score**时，查询新版安全分规则，否则默认查询旧版安全分规则。
description.en: Choose to query the new or old version of the security score rules. When the value is **home_security_score**, it queries the new version of the security score rules; otherwise, it defaults to querying the old version of the security score rules.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for request and response messages, default is **zh**. Values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
Resource directory member account ID (Alibaba Cloud account).
> You can obtain this parameter by calling the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) API.

description.zh:
安全分来源，传空默认为云安全中心，枚举值：

- 0：云安全中心。

- 1：瑶池控制台。
description.en:
Source of the security score. If left empty, it defaults to Cloud Security Center. Enumerated values:

- 0: Cloud Security Center.

- 1: Yaochi Console.
The IP address of the access source.

title.zh: 查询安全风险处理建议详情
title.en: Query Security Risk Handling Suggestions Details

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-secure-suggestion --source-ip 192.168.XX.XX --lang zh --cal-type home_security_score --source 0 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
